To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the economic behavior of the business entities is a complex and multi dimensional phenomenon, which is influenced by many factors, and the main ones are cultural values and institutional factors.

the economic behavior of the business entities is determined by their economic interests, cultural values and institutional conditions of the economic activity, and that it is impossible without a system holistic approach to study the endogenous links in the economic activity emerging between behavioral, cultural and institutional variables at the required level.

the endogenous links emerging in the economic behavior between business entities, cultural values and institutions are systemic and dynamic, and they cannot be studied at the required level of detail using the traditional approaches, mechanisms, and methods in the new economic reality.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the study of the endogeneity of the links between the economic activity of business entities, culture, and institutions, as well as the specifics of the system impact of ethic cultural values on the efficiency of business.

the study of the systemic links in economic behavior between business entities, cultural values and national institutions, the specifics of endogenous influence of cultural values and institutions in the economic efficiency of business, and with the development of a theoretical approach for a system study of endogenous relationships between behavioral, cultural and institutional variables, which is necessary to understand the nature and mechanisms for the formation and transformation of the national economic model.

the study of endogenous relationships between the economic efficiency of business activity and cultural and institutional variables in the conditions of neo industrialization, the specifics of the links between culture and institutions in the economic system, and the role of cultural values and institutions in the formation and development of the national economic model.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the research has a significant theoretical, methodological and practical importance and value.
the economic behavior of a business entity is a systemic endogenous phenomenon, which is influenced by cultural value variables and institutional factors.
the economic behavior of modern business entities is determined by the systemic endogenous relationships of the behavioral, cultural value, institutional variables.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the endogenous links in the economic efficiency of business activity are formed by the interaction of cultural and institutional variables.

the proposed approach allows to study the endogenous links of the economic behavior of entities and institutions, and the specifics of their interrelations in the context of the neo industrialization.

the proposed theoretical and methodological framework can be used in the further theoretical and empirical study of the endogenic links of behavioral, cultural values and institutional variables, as well as in practical activities aimed at increasing the economic efficiency of business and economic policy.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the endogenous links of behavioral and institutional variables are the main factor that determines the efficiency of economic activity of business entities and the effectiveness of economic policies.
the economic efficiency of business activities is largely dependent on the endogenous relationships between the behavioral, cultural value, institutional variables.
the endogenous links in the economic system of a country, as well as in the economic system in general, are determined by the endogenous links of the behavioral and institutional systems.
